newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Power rate in Philippine main island up 3.04 ctvs.
newsitem.headline: Power rate in Philippine main island up 3.04 ctvs.

text.p: The power rate in the main island of Luzon went up by 3.04 centavos per kilowatthour (kwh) to 2.1184 pesos per kwh starting August 26, the state-owned National Power Corp (Napocor) said on Tuesday.
Napocor president Guido Delgado said the higher rate was due to increased fuel price and the slight depreciation of peso against the dollar and the yen.
The Napocor adjusts its rates every month based on the cost of generated power and the foreign exchange.

Delgado said power rates in the central Cebu-Negros-Panay grid went down by 1.07 centavos to 2.1266 pesos per kwh. The rate in the Leyte-Samar grid likewise declined by 4.63 centavos to 2.1022 pesos per kwh.
The Bohol grid experienced a rate increase of 2.16 centavos to 2.2764 pesos per kwh, while the Mindanao grid up by 0.6 centavos to 1.3456 pesos per kwh.
